title: The Advent of Complex Metallurgy
version: IMEKO TC26 International Conference on Metrology for Archaeology and Cultural Heritage, pp. 339–344
lineage: Full proceedings version. Reports measurements on Southern Levantine finds independent of the Mehrgarh study.

passages.note: Organic inclusions from selected ceramic cores of cast objects were dated. The authors report a production interval of about 4700–3800 BCE and explicitly caution that the age of the Mehrgarh object is based on deposition context, so strict priority remains uncertain.
